sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 9)

purpose.zh: 练腿张开时还能主动抬起来，换腿扫得开
purpose.en: Trains your legs to lift while spread wide, so they sweep open when you switch.

text.zh: 腿伸直脚尖朝上，单腿抬离地面一点
text.en: Legs straight, toes up, lift one leg off the floor

text.zh: 抬起两三厘米就够，停两秒放下，左右轮流，两边各一次算 1 次。
text.en: Two or three centimetres is enough, pause, set it down, alternate; both sides is one rep.

text.zh: 背挺直，别往后仰着借力。
text.en: Sit tall, don't lean back to help.

cautions.zh: 背挺不直就屁股靠墙坐
cautions.en: If you can't sit tall, sit with your butt against a wall.

thomasSupplement.camera: 正前方（看分腿角度和抬起高度）
thomasSupplement.doseBrief: 3 组 × 每侧 6–10 次，每次停 2 秒
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
